decisions.reason: Adding the completed boards to JLCPCB for an order check does not change the existing component-sourceability or Extended-part policies.

The source contains no decision changing the AXP2101 battery or USB power-path design.
The JLCPCB order-setup check does not change the LED supply voltage, direct data drive, or level-shifter policy.
The source does not modify the BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitance requirements.
The preceding discussion resolves a module-pin misunderstanding, while the source Event only adds a manufacturing order check and does not change the breakout requirement.
